2020.analyst_notes: Confident, mission-led About page ('IBMers believe in progress') with a strong IBMer culture message and a long history section that takes up much of the page. Responsibility content (P-TECH, Trust Center, AI for social good) is present but brief, and the environment appears in only one line, so the classical environmental label is weak.

2021.change_reason: Headline cloud messaging is rewritten around hybrid cloud ('The world is going hybrid with IBM'), with new AI and quantum research entries and a 2-nanometer chip timeline item; culture and mission copy is unchanged.
2021.analyst_notes: The organizing story moves from 'the cloud for smarter business' to hybrid cloud, a meaningful strategic change that the classical signal (similarity 0.86, unchanged) misses. Tone is confident, but claims remain largely qualitative.

2022.change_reason: Near-identical to 2021: the Services label becomes Consulting, the CEO title becomes Chairman and CEO, and a Fellows quote is updated; the core messaging is the same.
2022.analyst_notes: The Services-to-Consulting relabel is a branding change worth tracking, but the messaging and emphasis are unchanged. The classical unchanged flag agrees.

2023.change_reason: The page is restructured around 'Creators, partners and clients putting technology to work in the real world'; the IBMers-believe-in-progress and people-centered messages are removed, and new sections cover a net-zero 2030 emissions goal, AI digital workers, and enterprise social good.
2023.analyst_notes: This is the clearest strategic shift in the series: culture and employee messaging drop out, and the page now centers on a business structure (Consulting, Software, Red Hat, Infrastructure, Ecosystem) and a specific net-zero pledge. The classical flag (True, similarity 0.03) is right on direction.

2024.change_reason: Adds specific programs (IBM Sustainability Accelerator and IBM SkillsBuild, aimed at traditionally underrepresented communities in technology), shortens the history timeline and FAQ, and updates product naming to watsonx Orchestrate.
2024.analyst_notes: More concrete on social programs, including explicit underrepresented-community language absent in 2023, and shorter overall. Employee and culture content is still absent. The classical flag (True, similarity 0.32) agrees.
